name: borgdock-video
description: Remotion compositions for the BorgDock launch video, rendered from the site's mock-data recordings.

scripts.render: remotion render Launch ../public/video/launch.mp4 && remotion still LaunchPoster ../public/video/launch.webp --frame=-1
scripts.render:short: remotion render Short ../public/video/short.mp4 && remotion still ShortPoster ../public/video/short.webp --frame=-1
scripts.render:hero: remotion render LaunchHero ../public/video/launch-hero.mp4 && remotion still LaunchPoster ../public/video/launch-hero.webp --frame=-1
scripts.render:hero-light: remotion render LaunchHero ../public/video/launch-hero-light.mp4 --props=props/light.json && remotion still LaunchPoster ../public/video/launch-hero-light.webp --frame=-1 --props=props/light.json
scripts.render:dispatch: remotion render DispatchHero ../public/video/dispatch-hero.mp4 && remotion still DispatchPoster ../public/video/dispatch-hero.webp --frame=-1
scripts.render:dispatch-light: remotion render DispatchHero ../public/video/dispatch-hero-light.mp4 --props=props/light.json && remotion still DispatchPoster ../public/video/dispatch-hero-light.webp --frame=-1 --props=props/light.json
scripts.render:quick-review: remotion render QuickReviewHero ../public/video/quick-review-hero.mp4 && remotion still QuickReviewPoster ../public/video/quick-review-hero.webp --frame=-1
scripts.render:quick-review-light: remotion render QuickReviewHero ../public/video/quick-review-hero-light.mp4 --props=props/light.json && remotion still QuickReviewPoster ../public/video/quick-review-hero-light.webp --frame=-1 --props=props/light.json
scripts.render:all: bun run render && bun run render:short && bun run render:hero && bun run render:hero-light && bun run render:dispatch && bun run render:dispatch-light && bun run render:quick-review && bun run render:quick-review-light
